crossRefs.note: You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.
God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear;” and it was so.
God called the dry land “earth”, and the gathering together of the waters he called “seas”. God saw that it was good.
He has described a boundary on the surface of the waters, and to the confines of light and darkness.
“Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke out of the womb,
when he gave to the sea its boundary, that the waters should not violate his commandment, when he marked out the…
Don’t you fear me?’ says Yahweh ‘Won’t you tremble at my presence, who have placed the sand for the bound of the sea…
With the blast of your nostrils, the waters were piled up. The floods stood upright as a heap. The deeps were congealed…
It shall be that when the soles of the feet of the priests who bear the ark of Yahweh, the Lord of all the earth, rest…
the waters which came down from above stood, and rose up in one heap a great way off, at Adam, the city that is beside…
You trampled the sea with your horses, churning mighty waters.

translations.web: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.
translations.bsb: He piles up the waters of the sea; He puts the depths into storehouses.
translations.kjv: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap: he layeth up the depth in storehouses.
translations.asv: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as a heap: He layeth up the deeps in store-houses.
